Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle, followed by Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien who will open for Ireland. Wellington Masakadza to start with the ball.
The chase is set to begin.

Ireland were terrific with the ball. They never let Zimbabwe got going and everyone bowled really well. Craig Young and Simi Singh were brilliant while Barry McCarthy too did well with the ball. Curtis Campher had a tough outing and he went off the field as well with an injury but they will be very happy with the performance. Ireland should chase this down comfortably. Do join us in a while on the other side.

Zimbabwe never got going as they kept on losing wickets at regular intervals. Only Regis Chakabva got going as he played a fine knock of 47 but he received little to no support from the other batters and they have finished with a very low score.

A very good bowling performance from Ireland. They have restricted Zimbabwe to a very low score and they will be very pleased with the effort. Zimbabwe though would be very disappointed with the effort and they would require a terrific effort to win this from here.
Play and a miss! Two dots on the trot to end the innings. A length ball, around off. Luke Jongwe looks to pull it away but the ball sneaks under the blade. Zimbabwe end their innings on 117 for 7.
Swing and a miss! A slower, full length ball, outside off. Jongwe looks to heave it away but misses.
On a length, outside off. Wellington Masakadza cuts it towards point for a single.

DROPPED! But it was a tough attempt. A length ball, on off. Jongwe looks to heave it away. The ball takes the outside edge and lobs towards cover. The fielder comes running in and puts in a forward drive but in vain. They take one.
Good length and on the bodyline. Wellington Masakadza pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off. Pushed to cover for a single.
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Luke Jongwe.

OUT! RUN OUT! Andy Balbirnie, you beauty! A full-length ball, around off. Wellington Masakadza works it towards long on. He calls for two. Andy Balbirnie collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Ryan Burl is running towards that end and he falls short.
A slower, length ball, outside off. Wellington Masakadza looks to go after it but misses.
A short ball, on off. Ryan Burl pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around off. Burl looks to push it to the off side. The ball takes the inside edge, scoots past the stumps and goes to fine leg. The batters take two.
Curtis Campher goes out because of a shoulder injury. Harry Tector replaces him.

IN THE AIR..SAFE! A length ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza pulls it away. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. Curtis Campher comes running in and puts a forward dive but he was unable to grab the ball cleanly. The batters take a single. It looks like Curtis Campher has hurt his shoulder. He looks in some pain.
A length ball, on off. Burl swings. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man. They take one.
EDGY! A full-length ball, on off. Burl looks to whip it across the line. The ball takes the outside edge and flies in the air. The ball falls just besides the stumps. The batters sneak one.

IN THE AIR...SAFE! A short ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza stays back and pulls it away. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards mid off. The ball falls short of the man there. They take one.
Full and on off. Burl pushes it to mid off for a single.
A dot now! Good-length ball, outside off. Burl hangs back and looks to chase it but misses.
Full length and on off. Wellington Masakadza skips down the track and slashes it to sweeper cover for a single.
A short ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza pulls it through mid-wicket. The batters take two easily.
A slower length ball, outside off. Burl hangs back and looks to latch onto it but misses.
Full and on off. Wellington Masakadza drills it to long on for a single.
A length ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza cuts it through point for a couple again.
A length ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza whips it towards long on. The fielder comes running in and puts in a dive to his right to save a boundary. The batters pick two.
A length ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza pulls it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Campher continues to find it difficult. A length ball, on the pads. Wellington Masakadza stays back and flicks it through square leg. The ball races away to the boundary.
Curtis Campher is back into the attack.

A full-length ball, on off. Wellington Masakadza defends it to point and takes off for a quick single. Paul Stirling comes running in, collects and underarms the ball at the striker's end, but the ball goes past the stumps.
On a length, on off. Burl comes across and tucks it to mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball, on the pads. Burl defends it to the left of the bowler.
A full-length ball, on off. Masakadza pushes it to cover for a single.
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Wellington Masakadza.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust. A length ball, outside off. Shumba stays back and looks to chase it but only manages to get an outside edge. Neil Rock has been excellent on his debut. He takes his second catch of the game. He must be over the moon. Good decision by, Andy Balbirnie of getting McCarthy back into the attack.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off. Burl defends it to cover for a quick single.
Barry McCarthy is back into the attack. His figures read 2-1-10-0 so far.
On off, kept out.
Loopy ball on middle, Burl works it to the leg side for one.
Tossed up on off, Shumba drives it to long off for a single.
Full on middle, pushed to mid on.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one.
Floated on middle and leg, Shumba flicks it to the leg side for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Shumba comes forward and drives it through cover for a single.
Around off. Shumba drives it to cover.
Full and on leg. Shumba tucks it to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Floated full and on middle. Burl nudges it to mid-wicket for another single.
A single now, as this is worked to mid on.
Short and on off. Shumba cuts it to point.
On off, tucks it to the leg side.
Flighted on off. Shumba flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Shamba looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits the pads. Singh appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Going down leg.
Quicker. Full and on off. Shumba defends it to cover.
Floated full and on off. Burl pushes it to cover for a single.
Who will come out at number 7? It is going to be Ryan Burl.

OUT! TIMBER! Regis Chakabva falls short of the half century which he was eyeing. Loopy ball, full and on off. Chakabva stays back and looks to guide it to the off side but misses it completely. The ball goes through to castle the stumps. Simi Singh now has two wickets under his name. Zimbabwe look in all sorts of trouble now.
Short and around the hips. Chakabva tucks it to square leg for a single. He moves to 47.
Full and on middle. Chakabva flicks it towards long on. The batters pick two. Good running,
Loopy ball, on off. Shumba pushes it to cover and rotates the strike.
Full and on off. Shumba defends it out.
Flighted full and on middle. Shumba flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Shumba looks to defend it out. He gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Loopy ball, on the pads. Shumba flicks it to square leg. He is off the mark with a single.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Milton Shumba.

OUT! CAUGHT! Simi Singh comes back into the attack and provides the team with a breakthrough. Loopy ball, on off. Ervine looks to go big, but he does not middle that one. Ervine comes down and whips it towards long on. Andy Balbirnie settles under it and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: A leg breaker now, on off. Regis Chakabva cuts it through cover for a single.
SIX! BANG! A touch short and on off. Chakabva stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Flatter and on off. Ervine works it to long off for a single.
Simi Singh is back into the attack.
Down leg. Chakabva looks to heave it away but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Going down leg.
Short and on leg. Chakabva stays back and looks to pull it away but misses.
Floated on the pads. Ervine flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Good use of the wrists! Loopy ball, full and on off. Ervine gets low and reverse sweeps it towards third man. The ball races away to the boundary.
Flighted full and on off. Ervine pushes it to cover. The fielder dives to his left to make a brilliant stop.
On middle, Regis Chakabva tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Chakabva tucks it to the leg side and takes a quick single.
A length ball, on off. Pushed to cover for a single.

SIX! BANG! Craig Ervine, the skipper is taking the charge now. A full length ball, on off. Ervine comes across and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder. The ball ends up in the stands for a maximum.
On a length and on the pads. Chakabva tucks it to square leg for a single.
A length ball, on off. Craig Ervine stays back and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full length and around off. Chakabva flicks it to mid-wicket for a single now.
Loopy ball, on off. Chakabva works it to long on for another single.
Full and on middle. Craig Ervine sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Craig Ervine drives it to cover, but cannot find the gap.
On off, Ervine defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up and outside off. Craig Ervine stays back and cuts it through point for a couple.
Short and on off. Regis Chakabva stays back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Who will walk out next? It is going to be Craig Ervine. Also a bowling change for Ireland. Benjamin White comes into the attack.

OUT! TIMBER! You miss, I hit. Shane Getkate put the pressure on the batsman with a couple of dots. Shane Getkate strikes in his first over. A length ball, on middle and off. Myers stays inside the crease and looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes through and hit the top of middle stump. This was a beauty and Zimbabwe slip further.
SWING AND A MISS! A full-length ball, outside off. Myers looks to go after it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Myers taps it to point.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off. Myers looks to have a poke at it but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Good running! Short ball and on off. Chakabva stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. The batters take three before the fielder cuts it out.
Full and on off. Chakabva flicks it to mid-wicket. The bowler gives it a chase. The batters pick two before Getkate cuts it off.
Shane Getkate comes into the attack now.
Tossed up, on off. Myers pushes it to cover. A good over by Simi Singh.
Loopy ball, on middle and leg. Chakabva flicks it to square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Chakabva nudges it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single. There is an overthrow and the batters get an extra run.
Darted on the pads. Myers tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, on off. Myers skips down the track and drives it to cover.
Tossed up, on off. Myers prods and works it towards long on. There is a misfield in the deep and the batters take two.
Simi Singh comes into the attack now.
On a length and outside off. Myers slashes it to third man. They take one more. 16 runs coming off the over.
Around the hips this time. Chakabva tucks it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Full and on the pads. Chakabva stays back and flicks it towards fine leg. The ball races away to the boundnary. An expensive first over for Curtis Campher till now.
FOUR! Nicely played. Back of a length, outside off. Chakabva plays late at it and cuts it through point. The ball races away to the boundary.
Full-length ball and on off. Chakabva cuts it through point for a couple. Good running.
FOUR! Regis Chakabva takes no time to put the debutant under pressure. A short ball, on off. Regis Chakabva hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Curtis Campher comes into the attack now.
A dot to end the over! A length ball, on middle. Myers stays inside the crease and defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, on the pads. Chakabva tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Clipped away! Full and on the pads. Regis Chakabva goes back and flicks it through square leg. The ball goes through the gap and into the ropes.
A length ball, on off. Myers guides it towards backward point for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A length ball, outside off. Myers stays back and cuts it through point. The ball races away to the boundary. Zimbabwe need more of this.

CLOSE! A length ball, sliding down leg. Myers stays back and looks to flick it away but misses. Neil Rock dives to his left to make a good take. Barry McCarthy hears some noise and puts in an appeal, but the umpire is unmoved.
On off, guided to third man for one.
Who will walk out at number 4? It is going to be Dion Myers.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket and Zimbabwe are in trouble. Good length ball outside off, Marumani looks to heave it away but it goes off the top edge to short third man where Paul Stirling takes a great catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, worked to the leg side for one.
Good length ball on off, Marumani looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
On a length outside off, Chakabva punches it to deep cover for a single.
Outside off, Regis Chakabva leaves it alone.
A length ball, on the pads. Tadiwanashe Marumani defends it to the leg side. He ventures out looking for a single but was sent back immediately by Regis Chakabva.
Five dots on the trot! A length ball, on off. Marumani defends it onto the pitch. Can Barry McCarthy get a maiden out of his first over?
Swing and a miss! On a length and outside off. Marumani looks to go after it but misses. The dots are piling up now.
A slower, full-length ball, just outside off. Marumani looks to chase it but misses. The ball dies before the keeper.
Good length and outside off. Tadiwanashe Marumani stays inside the crease and looks to go after it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Tadiwanashe Marumani stays back and defends it to point.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Craig Young strikes in his first over and draws the first blood. A full-length ball, around off. Wesley Madhevere looks to push it away but only manages to get an outside edge. Neil Rock, the debutant does the rest behind the wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Who will walk out next? It is going to be Regis Chakabva. Also, Barry McCarthy to bowl from the other end for Ireland.
Outside off, left alone.
Short ball and outside off. Wesley Madhevere stays back and looks to go after it but misses.
A length ball, on the pads. Marumani flicks it to square leg for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. The ball nips away off the pitch. Marumani leaves it alone.
Wesley Madhevere and Zimbabwe are off the mark straightaway. Young starts with a length ball, on off. Wesley Madhevere pushes it to cover for a single.

We are all set to begin the first T20I. The Ireland players make their way out to the middle, followed by the Zimbabwe openers. Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere. Craig Young to start with the ball.

Zimbabwe (PLAYING XI) - Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Regis Chakabva (WK), Dion Myers, Craig Ervine (C), Milton Shumba, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava.

Ireland (PLAYING XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Andy Balbirnie (C), Curtis Campher (T20I Debut), Neil Rock (WK) (T20I Debut), Shane Getkate, Simi Singh, George Dockrell, Craig Young, Barry McCarthy, Benjamin White.
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in the favour of Ireland. They have opted to field first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first game of the 5-match T20I series between Ireland and Zimbabwe. This series was scheduled for earlier August but some unforeseen circumstances forced the series to be postponed and here we are, starting with the first game in Dublin. Both these teams are coming into this series after a loss in their previous series and they would want to comeback. It is an important series for Ireland as they will be going straight to the T20 World Cup after this and they would want to fine tune their skills before this series. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, would just want to win and make it difficult for the Irish. What will happen? Let us find out as the toss is not far away.
